title: God isn’t destroying your life; He’s clearing the site. 🚧🏚️
paragraphs: God isn’t destroying your life; He’s clearing the site. 🚧🏚️
"God’s direction often feels like disruption before it feels like destiny."

We pray for a new season, but we panic when the old season starts falling apart. We ask for growth, but we complain about the pruning. You have to understand: You cannot build a Kingdom destiny on a foundation of comfort.

If your plans are being interrupted, if your circle is shaking, if your comfort zone is breaking—don’t run. God is making room for what He promised. The disruption is just the delivery system for your destiny.
📖 "See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it?" — Isaiah 43:19
Type "I TRUST YOU" if you are letting God lead, even in the chaos. ⚔️ Follow @iamGospelWarrior for daily encouragement.
